LanguageData.HR_HRE_001_Description: A displaced household asks for shelter. Accepting adds one generated colonist; no kinship is inferred.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_001_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_002_Description: Hiring adds one generated colonist; grain aid consumes real rice.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_002_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_003_Description: A retinue claims to carry a court message. The visit is a fictional local incident.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_003_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_004_Description: A local official asks for grain. Payment consumes rice; refusal can change registered community posture.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_004_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_005_Description: Two households dispute a field boundary. Food compensation consumes stored rice.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_005_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_006_Description: Households dispute access to water. Compensation consumes stored rice.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_006_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_007_Description: Repair costs rice; salvaging adds rice to colony stock.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_007_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_008_Label: Potter seeks a place to settle
LanguageData.HR_HRE_008_Description: Accepting adds an ordinary colonist, not a guaranteed skilled crafter.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_008_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_009_Description: With bronze casting adopted, commission a one-off bronze family vessel; this consumes 10 copper ore and 5 tin ore and records a unique relic.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_009_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_010_Description: Trade 20 rice for 10 copper ore and 5 tin ore, or spend 5 rice to adopt locally accessible bronze casting if its prerequisites are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_010_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_011_Description: Hiring adds an ordinary colonist; supplied timber is consumed.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_011_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_012_Description: Record a fictional family vessel as a unique map item, or transfer an existing registered vessel to a living descendant.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_012_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_012_C1_Description: Create and register one fictional vessel on the map, linked to a living colonist where possible.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_012_C2_Description: Transfers the registered vessel to the earliest-born living descendant of its recorded owner.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_013_Description: With a registered family vessel present, interpreting its fictional inscription can reveal Luoyi or deepen Zhou culture familiarity without creating a real historical claim.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_013_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_013_C1_Description: Reveals Luoyi through the existing world revelation manager.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_013_C2_Description: Increases recorded Zhou Central Plains cultural presence by 0.05.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_014_Label: A foreign family requests a rite
LanguageData.HR_HRE_014_Description: Hospitality consumes rice; the permitted gathering increases local familiarity with Zhou ritual culture.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_014_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_015_Description: Available only when at least two unpartnered adult colonists are recorded and no close-relative relationship is detected; marriage is persisted through HR-007 and RimWorld relations.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_015_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_016_Description: Disabled until HR-007 can verify kinship; no false family link is created.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_016_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_017_Description: Paying consumes rice; refusal records an autonomous posture when politics is initialized.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_017_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_018_Description: Medical aid consumes herbal medicine; food aid consumes rice.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_018_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_019_Description: The report appears only after the related historical event; no future event is revealed.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_019_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_020_Description: Disabled until a reliable cross-system migration operation exists.
LanguageData.HR_HRE_020_Trigger: Offered when the map and any listed resource or system requirements are met.
